text: Lead decision F10 (2026-11-02, under the owner brief of 2026-11-02; reported to the owner for confirmation): CREATE TABLE completes when the committed cohort at the stated epoch reaches the sealed quorum minimum and answers contractState under_replicated with the epoch and missing replica count (client NOTICE, admin envelope); below quorum PROVISIONING_UNAVAILABLE{epoch, reasons, retryAfterMs} -> SQLSTATE 57P03 via SQLSTATE_BY_ENGINE_ERROR_CODE. No degraded fallback, no minimum lowered to 1, no completion without a typed statement of what is missing. An owner reversal is an R09 supersession.
